players.bio: Ali Ibrahim Karim Ali Al-Hamadi (born 1 March 2002) is an Iraqi professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One side Sheffield Wednesday on loan from Premier League club Ipswich Town and the Iraq national team.

Barry Ryan Bannan (born 1 December 1989) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. and the Scotland national team. Bannan began his career at Celtic before making his senior debut in 2008 for Aston Villa, and was loaned to Derby County, Blackpool and Leeds United in the Championship.

Billy James Mitchell (born 7 April 2001) is an English footballer who plays for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Career Hailing from Orpington, Mitchell joined his boyhood club Millwall at under-15 level. His father's family originates from Bermondsey and are also Millwall fans, so is his maternal great-grandfather.

Callum Slattery is an English professional central midfielder who plays for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. He officially agreed a three-year contract with the Owls on 29 June 2026, joining the club on a free transfer.

Connal Joe Trueman (born 26 March 1996) is an English footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. He joined Birmingham City as an 11-year-old in 2007, made his Football League debut for them in 2018, and was released in 2022 after 15 years with the club.
Davis James Marshall Keillor-Dunn (born 2 November 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday.
Di'Shon Joel Bernard (born 14 October 2000) is a professional footballer who plays for Sheffield Wednesday. Born in England, he represents the Jamaica national team.
Ernie Luke Weaver (born 8 September 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Sheffield Wednesday F.C. in EFL League One.
Gabriel Algirdas Babatunde Otegbayo (born 11 February 2005) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Sheffield Wednesday.
Harry Andrew Gray (born 8 October 2008) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday on loan from Premier League club Leeds United.
Henrik Pedersen (born 2 January 1978) is a Danish football manager who is currently the manager of EFL Championship club Sheffield Wednesday.

Jaden Emile Tyrone Heskey (born 17 December 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Early life and career Jaden Emile Tyrone Heskey was born on 17 December 2005 in Manchester. He joined the academy at Manchester City aged eight. After progressing through the age-groups he captained the club at U18 level.

Jamal Akua Lowe (born 21 July 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward and winger for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday and the Jamaica national team. He was born in England and played for the England C team, before making his full international debut for Jamaica in 2021. Lowe began his professional playing career with Barnet in 2012.
Jarvis Harry Thornton (born 10 January 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday.
Joseph Patrick Lumley (born 15 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday.
Jordi Baininwa Liongola (born 17 May 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Born in Belgium, he plays for the Burundi national team.

Kieran Morrison is a 19-year-old professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday, on loan from Premier League giants Liverpool. Born in Manchester, he represents the Northern Ireland national team at the senior international level.

Liam David Ian Cooper (born 30 August 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Born in England, he played for the Scotland national team. Cooper came through the youth academy at Hull City before making his debut with the first team at the age of 16.

Liam Jordan Palmer is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or right-back for and captains EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. He has also played nationally for Scotland under-19 and Scotland under-21.
Louie Mark Barry (born 21 June 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker and winger for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday.
Mason Paul James Burstow (born 4 August 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for Sheffield Wednesday, on loan from Premier League side Hull City.

Max Josef Lowe (born 11 May 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back or defensive midfielder for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. He has represented England at under-16, under-17, under-18 and under-20 level.

Reece James (born 7 November 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. His usual position is as a left-back, but also occasionally plays in midfield.

Ricardo Alexandre Almeida Santos born 18 June 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Born in Portugal, he represents the Cape Verde national team.

Sean Sheunesu Fusire (born 31 May 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre midfielder for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Born in England, he plays international football for Zimbabwe.

Sil Laurentius Swinkels is a Dutch footballer who currently plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Swinkels is a product of the Aston Villa and Vitesse Arnhem academies and has played for the Netherlands internationally at youth levels up to under-18.

Tyler Jaden Napier Edward Onyango is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder, centre-back or right-back for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. On 24 January 2021, Onyango made his first-team debut for Everton when he came off of the bench to replace André Gomes in the 85th minute of an FA Cup fourth round victory over Sheffield Wednesday.

William Grainger (born 20 November 2008) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club Sheffield Wednesday. Early life He went to school at Wales High School in Kiveton Park.

Yan Valery (born 22 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Sheffield Wednesday. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team. He began his senior career in England with Premier League club Southampton and spent the second half of the 2020–21 season on loan at Championship club Birmingham City before joining Angers in 2022.
